newsitem.title: USA: CBOT Dec corn rallies further on crop estimate.
newsitem.headline: CBOT Dec corn rallies further on crop estimate.

text.p: CBOT December corn rallied further in fast dealings on reports of a bullish crop estimate from the Professional Farmers of America, traders said.
Traders said there were reports Pro Farmer pegged the 1996 U.S. crop at 8.2 billion bushels, below USDA's August forecast for 8.695 billion bushels.
Gains in September were limited by a slide in the cash basis market amid early harvesting of corn in the U.S. southern growing region.
At 1117 CDT, corn was four to nine cents per bushel higher, with December up nine at $3.48-1/2 a bushel.
